import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
ax = sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud', data=df, palette='viridis')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Number of Transactions')
plt.title('Transaction Type Distribution: Fraud vs Non-Fraud')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Is Fraud', labels=['Non-Fraud', 'Fraud'])
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
